title: VerifyRank: verification-aware evaluation of ranked environmental monitoring
description: VerifyRank 0.2.0 evaluates frozen ranking recommendations against incomplete binary reference evidence, preserves shared outcomes, and prioritizes recoverable unique references under declared cost and recovery scenarios. This archive contains original project software, documentation and explicitly synthetic fixtures under MIT; it excludes methane observations and provider-derived case tables. The sole human creator is junjiezhang. OpenAI Codex assisted with design, implementation, testing and documentation; AI tools are not authors. Computational tests do not establish physical label validity or operational deployment.
